calendarFaqs.q: When does CUSD start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Capistrano Unified starts the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 16, 2027. It is a minimum day for elementary and middle school students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Winter Recess, and when does school resume?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 20 through December 31, 2027. School resumes Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Spring Recess in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, April 3, through Friday, April 7, 2028. School resumes Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CUSD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 1, 2028. CUSD lists it as a minimum day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CUSD dates are minimum days or pupil-free days?
calendarFaqs.a: November 1 and December 17 are K–12 pupil-free days. Minimum-day schedules include August 16 for elementary and middle school students, elementary conference windows November 2–5 and February 28–March 2, high school final-exam windows December 14–16 and May 30–June 1, and June 1 for all students. Check the assigned school for exact dismissal times.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CUSD have school on November 11–12, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: No. CUSD lists Veterans Day on Thursday, November 11, and Veterans Day Recess on Friday, November 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official CUSD 2027–28 PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link in Downloads. The source is the CUSD calendar Board approved April 22, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the CUSD calendar to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MySchoolDates provides a one-time ICS file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook. It does not sync with later district changes, so confirm updates with CUSD.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
whatsNew.subtitle: Student dates and CUSD schedule details that differ from the prior school year.
content: School starts August 16, two days earlier than the August 18 opening in 2026–27.
The last student day is June 1, two days earlier than June 3 in 2026–27.
CUSD lists Veterans Day Recess through Friday, November 12, in addition to Veterans Day on November 11.
The K–12 pupil-free days are November 1 and December 17, one calendar day earlier than the corresponding dates in 2026–27.
The middle, elementary, and high school Back-to-School Night windows each move one calendar day earlier.

sourceReviewDetails: CUSD's calendars page identifies the 2027–28 calendar as Board approved April 22, 2026; it is not labeled revised.
The calendar lists November 1 and December 17 as K–12 pupil-free days and uses “Minimum Day” for shortened student schedules.
CUSD lists Veterans Day on November 11 and Veterans Day Recess on November 12 for students and teachers.
School-level dismissal times, Back-to-School Night dates, graduation details, and later changes should be confirmed with CUSD or the assigned school.
